text:
ashley_product: Heads up  Customer wants a pilot: 'Extended Audit Assurance' (EAA). Core asks: 7y retention, BYOK attestations, signed delivery manifests, and the ability to pull chain-of-custody for audits. They're asking what we can ship in Q2.
liam_security: Summary of security implications: extended retention expands SOC2/ISO artifact set; BYOK-in-place requires per-tenant key pointers + attestation flow; exports require envelope encryption and signed manifests. Need to map to controls.
paige_legal: Legal needs explicit custody language and termination export guarantees. Also need clarity on who pays for long-term storage and e-discovery. Asking for a draft acceptance checklist to attach to the SOW.
sam_engineering: From infra POV we can offer two launchable pilots: 
1) Export-first: monthly encrypted snapshot to customer bucket + signed manifest. Low infra lift.
2) In-place BYOK: store encrypted logs in-system referencing customer keys. Higher lift (key lifecycle, attestation verification).
jordan_sre: Ops constraints: whichever path we pick must include legal_hold toggle, signed manifests with checksums, restore playbook, and test plan for legal_hold exercises. Also need RTO/RPO targets.
megan_sales: Customer prefers in-system retention because they want searchability for e-discovery. They're open to paying for indexing. They asked for a proposal and pricing bands.
ashley_product: Proposed minimal acceptance criteria for pilot (draft):
- retention_tier = "EAA-pilot" TTL=7y
- key_strategy = ["BYOK_inplace","monthly_export"] (default: monthly_export)
- delivery = monthly snapshot + signed manifest (SHA256) stored to customer bucket; proof of delivery saved for 10y
- evidence_api = endpoints to request manifests and trigger on-demand exports (RBAC'd)
- legal_hold = immediate suspend-expiry toggle + audit trail
- audit_playbook = restore steps, checksum verification, escalation flow
- compliance_mapping = crosswalk to SOC2 CC controls and ISO clauses
- pricing = storage+egress+indexing tiers (tbd)
paige_legal: Also add: termination_handoff = 30d export window + verification procedures; indemnity cap language TBD.
liam_security: Add: require KMS attestation token at enrollment, attestations rotated annually, enforce envelope encryption (customer KEK) for exports, and proof logs that decryption keys never stored in our plaintext memory.
sam_engineering: Initial cost/effort estimate: export-first pilot ~0.5 FTE x 6w + infra ops; in-place BYOK pilot ~1.5 FTE x 10-12w + audit work. Indexing add-on estimated separately.
ashley_product: Risk assessment: in-place retention raises long-term audit scope and may require external SOC2 re-audit at customer request. Recommend defaulting to export-first with an indexed paid add-on.
jordan_sre: Runbook items (skeleton): pause-resume TTL CLI, manual export flow, manifest verification steps, restore verify steps, oncall playbook for failed exports.
megan_sales: For pricing, I'll draft bands: basic(export-only), premium(indexed+search), enterprise(in-place+BOK+full-support). Customer OK to review next Wed.
paige_legal: Legal will prep SOW language for custody, termination, and e-discovery cost allocation. Need product/security sign-off by EOD Tue to move to customer review.
opsbot: New doc created: https://tiny.redwood/EAA-pilot-proposal (internal) :page_facing_up:
ashley_product: Action items:
- ashley_product + liam_security: finalize acceptance checklist PR to /docs/compliance-pilots by Tue EOD
- sam_engineering: provide firm estimate + staging plan by next Mon
- jordan_sre: runbook skeleton by next Mon
- megan_sales: draft pricing bands and customer-facing proposal by Tue
- paige_legal: draft SOW clauses by Wed
megan_sales: I'll coordinate a customer review slot next Wed 11am PT.
liam_security: I'll add an example attestation flow and sample PKCS#11 attestation blob to the PR.
ashley_product: Agreed. Keep replies short in this thread. If anyone blocks, ping me directly.
